text: The success methods receive newIds by const array reference, and the stored callback signatures accept the same const reference. This landing removes std::move from those callback arguments. The message listener's separate header Clone and the constructor's move of its owned callable are unchanged. Exact original and renamed accepted signatures support the borrowed-array contract; diagnostic use-after-move wording is not a reproduced ownership failure or measured copy count. Earlier broad first-pass lessons stay provisional.
title: The simple Exchange success callbacks borrow their identifier arrays
